name: Envestnet MoneyGuide
description:
MoneyGuide is Envestnet’s financial planning software used to build goals-based plans that connect client conversations into actionable investment strategies.

This connector gives Claude read-only access to select MoneyGuide data an advisor is already entitled to see, so they can ask questions in plain language.

Claude can provide a plan snapshot including plan health, goals, and net worth summary.

Useful for researching account information, preparing meeting materials, or analyzing clients and plans across your business.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Envestnet MoneyGuide to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Envestnet MoneyGuide to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.moneyguidepro.com/ifa/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Envestnet MoneyGuide MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Envestnet MoneyGuide provides these MCP tools: get_snapshot_summary and search_households.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Envestnet MoneyGuide?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Envestnet MoneyGuide in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Envestnet MoneyGuide MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Envestnet MoneyGuide requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Envestnet MoneyGuide is developed by Envestnet. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
